newsitem.title: USA: Comm. Systems Corro-Shield sales jump.
newsitem.headline: Comm. Systems Corro-Shield sales jump.

text.p: Communications Systems Inc said Monday sales of its Corro-Shield product increased 85 percent in the second quarter, boosting overall revenues and earnings.

Sales of the gel-filled, corrosion-resistant connectors were particularly strong to U.S. regional Bell companies and to telecommunications companies in the Philippines and the Caribbean, and Communications Systems said it sees that trend continuing in the second half of the year.

"(T)he company's performance during this (second half) period is expected to benefit from the continuation of growing Corro-Shield orders and increased volumes of business in Asian and other international markets," the company said in a statement.
Communications Systems reported second quarter income from continuing operations of $0.31 a share versus $0.18. Sales from continuing operations rose 23 percent to $20.18 million.
The gross margin rose to 31.5 percent from 28.1 percent a year earlier.
Communications Systems is a telecommunications company that designs and manufactures connecting devices and wiring systems.
